## ✨ Added

- A new S3 Region field (`S3_REGION`) sets the region Garage answers to, for clients that only accept AWS region names such as `us-east-1`. It is written into `/config/garage.toml` on every start, so it also works on existing installs without editing the file. Left empty, the region in the file stays as it is. A value with characters that would break the config is refused with a clear line in the log, and Garage keeps running.
- A compose file and notes for running Garage on other Docker hosts (Synology, Proxmox), plus buttons to install it from the MOS Hub, ZimaOS and Umbrel.
